g.text: Average earnings of Punjab's urban workers rise with age, peaking at ages 55-59

Source: PSLM 2019-20. Sample: earners aged 15-64, Punjab urban (n = 3768). Weighted by hhweight (band means only). Red markers = weighted mean of each 5-year band; hollow markers = fewer than 30 observations. Points outside the axis range are not shown.
